name: Anna Strolenberg - § 101/2
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: regardless of their nationality, place of birth or residence status,
part_context: Underlines that third-country nationals in the EU, regardless of their nationality, place of birth or residence status, must be treated in a non-discriminatory manner; points out that third-country nationals have the right to apply for international protection under international and EU law, including in accordance with the principle of non-refoulement; calls on the Commission to support the Member States in upholding the rule of law and the fundamental rights enshrined in the Charter and in implementing the legislation adopted by the co-legislators; stresses the binding nature of the rulings of the CJEU and the ECtHR;
